CLOUD FIXER seat for PR #2704 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 859b74ba8ab4d0020025895b73a53b3833b5e74c. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main. Fetch 859b74ba8ab4d0020025895b73a53b3833b5e74c for the base you were given.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-policy-fixer-md, then write the PR body and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-policy-fixer-md <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-policy-fixer-md; that second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fixer repair, topic r10-policy-fixer-md, PR #2704 (branch fix/r10-policy-fixer-md, head 859b74ba8ab4d0020025895b73a53b3833b5e74c). Verify with git show 928ca213e7158b7b0747675c63097ca1ec6b54fd:<roster file> that the text of each carry landed; do not trust carry_audit.py alone, it does not read whether the text landed.
2. FIGURES. The verdict found two figures that do not re-derive: item 11 (body says median 98 min and sum 6640 min; reviewer rebuilt 27 class-open entries, 6297 min, median 126 min, over 25 inputs, using %cd UTC commit times and de-duplicating Fix review: subjects by line) and mutant 2b (body says 2 errors, reviewer got TOTAL: 1 error, tokens 1348 > 1336, restoring the cut adjective clause rewrapped to the same 2 lines). Re-derive both with a stated command in ## Figures and restate or correct them. If a figure can only be reproduced one way, say which.
3. No code or policy change is expected beyond the body. If a body edit changes nothing in the tree, push the handoff-body ref with body_push.sh and run prepr to a pass at your head first.
